class BS {
  public Feature getLicenseFeature() {
    return f;
  }
  public void doB() {
    if (!ready("a;b") || !isOperational()) return;
    b();
  }
  public void doC() {
    if (!ready("{") || !isOperational()) return;
    c();
  }
}
